name: 11434-eagle3decode-8b-4gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the target, with lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B as the EAGLE3 draft head. The target is the ungated mirror of the gated meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, under the Llama 3.1 Community License; same weights, same config shape fields.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: Target LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, GQA 32/8 heads, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, served float16 sharded TP4. Draft LlamaForCausalLMEagle3, one decoder layer, float16, max_position_embeddings 2048.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 300 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix structure, seed 42. Prompts 512 +- 64 tokens clamped to [256, 768]; generations a fixed 1024 tokens. `temperature: 0` and `ignore_eos: true`, so every request generates its full length. The clamps are forced by the 2048-token context cap: 768 + 1024 = 1792 leaves room for the 64-position draft tree.
purpose: A single-user long-form writing assistant on an 8B model with speculative drafting, producing 1024-token replies across four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang launch configuration.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented or nested line is skipped, so a key written inside a block
# is silently not passed to the engine. host/port/served-model-name are set by the serving layer.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 4

# fp16, NOT the target checkpoint's native bf16: the draft head below is a float16 checkpoint.
dtype: float16

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE3
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 5
speculative-eagle-topk: 16
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 64

attention-backend: flashinfer

# REQUIRED: the draft head declares `max_position_embeddings: 2048` and sglang overrides the draft
# model's context length with the TARGET's (131072 here), which raises unless
# SGLANG_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN=1 -- and nothing here can set an environment variable.
context-length: 2048

random-seed: 42
